items.title: How (And Why) To Build A Gold Farm ▫ Minecraft Survival Guide S3 [Ep.139]
items.description: The Minecraft Survival Guide Season 3 continues in Minecraft 26.3: Wilderness Bound! In today's video, I finally build a gold farm! But the reason I build one is unexpected: I need more gravel. Concrete Stairs and Slabs were added in 26.3, so the opportunities to build with concrete just expanded enormously - as long as we have a good supply of both sand and gravel. While renewable sand can only be obtained in tiny quantities from the Wandering Trader, renewable gravel is possible thanks to Piglin Bartering - but we need to pay the piglins. The solution? Finally build a gold farm! We also take a look at where you can acquire gravel at short notice in the overworld, take not of the other resources that piglin bartering provides renewable supply of, and squeeze in a quick reminder of how crafter circuits work. items.title: The One Block Furniture Update That Changed Everything ▫ Minecraft Survival Guide S3 [Ep.138]
items.description: The Minecraft Survival Guide Season 3 continues in Minecraft 26.3: Wilderness Bound! In today's video, we take a look at Minecraft cushions, which are basically a whole furniture update in a single block (with 16 colours!) We explore how cushions are crafted, where they can be placed, and how to adapt your existing furniture to using these new seats. They aren't just furniture, either: we use them to design custom lilypads, keep redstone circuits switched on permanently, and even display trophy items. We also unpack the potential of wool stairs and slabs, concrete stairs and slabs, and the site of a new witch hut near a freshly discovered Dappled Forest. items.title: How To Find the Dappled Forest (without Chunkbase!) ▫ Minecraft Survival Guide S3 [Ep.137]
items.description: The Minecraft Survival Guide Season 3 continues in Minecraft 26.3: Wilderness Bound! In today's video, we update to the new Minecraft gameplay drop, and immediately go in search of the new Abandoned Camp structure. With the help of some Explorer Maps, we are soon on the trail of the Dappled Forest, a biome with autumn colours, Poplar trees with a new wood type and three new leaf colours, red shrubs, shelf mushrooms, and opportunities for a fall or halloween build. This video will explain how to locate a Dappled Forest within your world without relying on external seed mapping tools like Chunkbase, shows where to look for loot and secret chests in Abandoned Camps, and provides an overview of the new Dappled Forest biome features. items.title: Finding The Dappled Forest In Survival Minecraft
items.description: Mojang has released Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 1, bringing the first chance for Java Edition players to get hands-on experience with the Dappled Forest, Poplar Wood, shelf mushrooms, and wool slabs & stairs in vanilla Minecraft! I explore the snapshot in a fresh Survival world, starting from scratch and searching for the Dappled Forest. We encounter and loot the new Abandoned Camp sites, taking a brief look at wool stairs. Then we discover a Dappled Forest and get to grips with the biome colour, Poplar Wood and its three leaf colours, shelf mushrooms, and the other quirks of this new biome. We also check out the new mushroom soup recipe, try building a custom tree with the new poplar leaves, and discuss where the update has room for improvement - notably shelf mushroom placement, and map colours. ---- GNU Paranor001 #minecraft #Snapshot #DappledForest #Poplarwood
items.content: Mojang has released Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 1, bringing the first chance for Java Edition players to get hands-on experience with the Dappled Forest, Poplar Wood, shelf mushrooms, and wool slabs & stairs in vanilla Minecraft! I explore the snapshot in a fresh Survival world, starting from scratch and searching for the Dappled Forest. We encounter and loot the new Abandoned Camp sites, taking a brief look at wool stairs. Then we discover a Dappled Forest and get to grips with the biome colour, Poplar Wood and its three leaf colours, shelf mushrooms, and the other quirks of this new biome. We also check out the new mushroom soup recipe, try building a custom tree with the new poplar leaves, and discuss where the update has room for improvement - notably shelf mushroom placement, and map colours. ---- GNU Paranor001 #minecraft #Snapshot #DappledForest #Poplarwood

items.title: GIGGS Dungeons & Dragons - Session 6: "Heart of the City"
items.description: Welcome to GIGGS Dungeons & Dragons - in which I, your humble dungeon master Pixlriffs, guide four of the five members of GIGGS (whom you may know from the Hermitcraft Server) through their first time playing Dungeons & Dragons (5th Edition, 2024 rules.) This is Session 6, in which the Deviled Eggs take on a fearsome red dragon wyrmling in the Mythreach Summer Tournament, and claim the prize on behalf of the fey king... A few edits were made to this VOD to cut around us troubleshooting some technical issues. Players: @GeminiTayMC, @Grian, @impulseSV, @GoodTimesWithScar Virtual Tabletop: Foundry VTT All Music by Francis Bonin @francisboninmusic Timestamps: 0:00 Pre-stream chat 2:26 Players join 14:30 The game begins! 2:55:31 Session ends / Stars & Wishes 3:07:31 Post-stream chat
